gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: MJD values for the two instants that straddle the 1972-12-31 leap second
ADDED i2: A regular day has 86400 seconds; 1972-12-31 had an extra leap second (86401 s)
ADDED i3: Compute the duration looking *backward* from 1973-01-01 to 1972-12-31
ADDED i4: The duration is negative because end precedes start. Its magnitude is 86401 s (not 86400) because 1972-12-31 carried a positive leap second.
